title: Sudesh Devi v. the State of Uttar Pradesh and Another
coram: Manoj Kumar Gupta, J., Ram Manohar Narayan Mishra, J., Manoj Misra, J. and Vikas Budhwar, J.
disposition: Writ disposed of; petitioner relegated to Clause 6.5
headnote: A consumer who challenges an electricity bill and seeks a writ quashing the bill or restraining disconnection is relegated to Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. If the consumer applies under that clause, the competent authority is to consider and decide it in accordance with law. The Court does not examine the bill.
facts: Sudesh Devi challenged an electricity bill. The Court treated the grievance as one against an electricity bill and pointed the petitioner to Clause 6.5 before the competent authority.

holding_units.holding: A writ seeking quashing of an electricity bill and/or a restraint on disconnection is disposed of without examining the bill. The consumer has a remedy before the competent authority under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

principle_tags.application: A writ challenging an electricity bill is disposed of without examining the bill; the consumer is pointed to Clause 6.5.

not_decided.point: Merits of the disputed electricity bill
